description: detection control for the source-embedded pair, run before any product scenario relies on it: no generate step runs (the entrypoint and crate keys the kind requires go unused); the one exercise step runs the harness itself, through its fx-env link under a harness name, over the materialized copy of this scenario's committed inner suite. Its agree scenario's pair matches and passes; its diverge scenario's embedded run exits 3 where the --source run exits 0, and declares exit 3 so that only the pair's comparison can fail it. The inner run must exit 1 with exactly that one failure, reporting the exit and both streams as differing from the --source run; the --source stdout it reports ends with the reading's sources item, whose paired source's kind and pinned fields the comparison blanks (1302 bytes)

command: ln "$(command -v fx-env)" kdlith-fixtures || exit 2; ./kdlith-fixtures --fx-suite inner --fx-kdlith "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" --fx-scratch-root inner-scratch --test-threads 1 2>&1; status=$?; echo "inner exit=$status"; test "$status" -eq 1
stdout-contains:
test agree   ... ok
---- diverge ----
  - source-embedded: exit 3 differs from the --source run's 0
  - source-embedded: stdout differs from the --source run's at byte 0 (0 vs 1302 bytes)
  - source-embedded: stderr differs from the --source run's at byte 0
test result: FAILED. 1 passed; 1 failed
inner exit=1
